title: In My Town, You Get Your Shadow at 13. Mine Came Early 😨
description: A CreepyCartoonTales story. What would you do? Tell us in the comments.
lines: In my town, you get your shadow on your thirteenth birthday.
Before that, kids don't have one. That's normal here.
Last night, I saw a shadow on my wall.
And it moved when I moved.
"Shadows that come early are borrowed," she whispered.
She pointed at Grandpa's photo on the wall.
In the photo, he didn't have a shadow anymore.
*Then the shadow on my wall waved. I wasn't moving.
That night, Grandpa called for the first time in years.
He said only one thing: "Take good care of it. I want it back when you turn thirteen."
